crossRefs.note: In Yahweh, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?
If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,
Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she…

translations.web: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
translations.bsb: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
translations.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.
translations.asv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.
